answer: Reef spot-audit lottery: each identity locks 70 credits, claims a reef plot, and posts a cipher-sealed pulse each epoch. Each epoch the lottery draws plots to audit: the drawn plot replays its pulse log against the cipher seal; a copied or rented pulse fails and burns its 70 bond. One identity pays 55 per epoch; 1,000 fakes pay 55,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent tends one plot, pays 55, keeps its share.
